explication: Fleet is a cross-platform device-management and security platform. Operators use its UI, APIs, or CLI to configure device management, deploy software, run queries, and inspect inventory and compliance; enrolled devices report data and receive management actions. The graph includes those documented capability areas and the live-query flow evidenced in sampled source. Most service wiring and feature implementations were not sampled, so uncertain internal links are omitted.
